title: Crafting panel: recipe slot column, materials row, 'Required Objects', craft to cursor, hold-to-craft, no flicker
player_outcome: Crafting sits in a bottom-left column of item slots, as in Terraria. The selected recipe is enlarged, with its materials as small slots (red count when you are short) and 'Required Objects: Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil'. Clicking puts the result on your cursor; holding right-click crafts faster and faster. Tooltips stay put instead of vanishing every half second.
design: Core: `RecipeBook.CraftInto(ref ItemStack cursor, CompiledRecipe r, Inventory inv, IReadOnlySet<string> stations, ConditionContext ctx)`. It merges into a cursor holding the same item with space left, refuses when the cursor holds something else, and uses the same atomic input removal as Craft. Also `CraftingEnvironment.Signature(List<Entry>)`, a stable hash of (recipe id, CanCraft, MaxCrafts).

Rewrite game/UI/CraftingPanel.cs and add CraftingPanel.Recipe.cs.
- A ScrollContainer of pooled recipe ItemSlotViews (SlotKind.Crafting; the selected one CraftingSelected at 1.25×), scrolled with the mouse wheel.
- Detail area: the output slot; a 'Materials' HBox of 32 px ingredient slots whose count label turns red when short (group ingredients read 'Any Wood'); 'Required Objects: …' from Core StationNames; plus condition and liquid text.
- A 'Show all' hammer toggle lists known but uncraftable recipes greyed. The default is craftable only.

Refresh only on change:
- A dirty flag set from PlayerInventory.Backpack.Changed, rebuilding at most once per frame.
- A 0.5 s poll of the station and liquid sets that dirties only when the HashSets differ.
- Rebuild only when Signature differs; otherwise update counts in place.
- Remove the unconditional 0.5 s Refresh (CraftingPanel.cs:38-43) and QueueFree loop (:51).

Actions:
- Left-click on the output: CraftInto the cursor, with the craft sound.
- Shift-click: craft as many as fit into the backpack (the existing loop).
- Right-button hold: CraftInto repeatedly at HoldRepeat.IntervalTicks, with the sound throttled to one per 0.1 s.
- Refusals go to the StatusLine.
UiCommands gains `ui craft <item> [n]`, which clicks the recipe's output via the panel path. UiProbes gains `ui.recipes`.
files_modify: game/UI/CraftingPanel.cs — slot column, detail, refresh on change, hold-to-craft
files_add: game/UI/CraftingPanel.Recipe.cs — selected-recipe detail and materials row
tests:
ui.cmds:
- `place work_bench 3 0 0` / `give wood 20` / `ui inventory` / `wait 0.6` / `assert ui.recipes > 0`.
- `ui craft wooden_sword` / `assert inv.cursor == 1`.
- `ui close` / `assert inv.wooden_sword == 1`.
verification: Manual/lavapipe: hover a recipe for 3 s and the tooltip stays; the station line reads display names; F3 gd.inventory_ui stays low when idle
risks: The NPC phase's Guide 'help' slot should reuse the recipe slot view and detail builder; keep them public.
